items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: her collaborations include work with Jon Hendricks, Fred Hersch, Bobby McFerrin, and Take 6.

ctx.x: Janis Siegel has enjoyed a creative career as a solo jazz singer and as a member of Manhattan Transfer. She is a nine time Grammy award winner, and her collaborations include work with Jon Hendricks, Fred Hersch, Bobby McFerrin, and Take 6.
Janis was interviewed in Clinton, New York on May 22, 2015 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
